about:
Car Parts New Haven operates as a used and pre-owned auto parts retailer in New Haven, Connecticut. The business serves vehicle owners and mechanics seeking replacement components for damaged or worn parts. While the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the store has established a presence in the local market and ships parts across the United States and Canada.

The company specializes in used BMW parts and general automotive components, offering both parts sales and whole vehicle sales through its "Car parts And Car Sales" line. Inventory is sourced from salvage and trade-in channels, with the storefront providing a physical location for customer pickup and inspection. No manufacturing or refurbishment processes are performed on-site; the operation functions as a distribution point for pre-owned components.

Primary customers include individual vehicle owners and independent repair shops needing cost-effective replacement parts. The business caters to the automotive aftermarket sector, with a noted focus on BMW models. Shipping coverage extends to all U.S. states and Canada, allowing remote orders beyond the New Haven area.

The store emphasizes customer service and competitive pricing as differentiators, citing word-of-mouth referrals driven by staff knowledge and honesty. Reviews highlight transparent transactions and reliable parts availability, though no formal certifications or quality standards are advertised.
